text: The factory is paused, by @gitdek's call on 2026-09-29, until it's in a better place to run for real. It was making work faster than he could take it: drafts, plans and reviews that each waited on him. Until he resumes it, coding agents build changes by hand in sessions, through pull requests with the gate, and hand nothing to the factory: no invariant label and no /invariant command. Its watchers' launchd services are disabled, and enabling them resumes it. D-0105 stays the goal.
